name: Nyan Lin Kyaw
bio: Nyan holds an Honours Bachelor of Commerce in Business Technology Management (Magna Cum Laude) from the University of Ottawa, where he currently serves as a Research Assistant. Building on his academic success, he recently secured a prestigious Master's offer in Management Analytics at McGill University. During his undergraduate studies, he gained professional experience in data analytics within the software security and finance sectors. As the Founder of BladeX Education, Nyan leads initiatives to help students navigate higher education while contributing as a mentor and advisor to other organizations. He specializes in strategic major exploration and comprehensive application planning, helping students build clear, actionable roadmaps to their dream universities.

name: Nang Sayoon Noi
bio: Nang Sayoon Noi moved to the US at the age of 16 to pursue higher education at Sacramento City College. She earned an A.S. in Biology before transferring to California State University, Sacramento, where she completed a B.S. in Biochemistry with Chemistry Honors. Her Chemistry Honors thesis investigated the correlation between social behavior and aging. Throughout her undergraduate studies, Sayoon received numerous departmental and institutional scholarships, awards and research grants in recognition of her academic and research excellence. She is currently working in the biotechnology industry, supporting the production of high-precision cell therapies for the treatment of hematological malignancies. Sayoon will soon begin pursuing a fully funded PhD in Molecular Biosciences at Rutgers University.
current_studies: Bachelor of Science in Biochemistry (Chemistry Honors)
area_of_expertise: Scholarship Applications, Graduate School Preparation, Personal Statement Writing, CV Preparation,  Research Field Selection,  Biotechnology Industry Careers
major_subject_expertise: Biochemistry, Cell and Molecular Biology, Genetics, Organic Chemistry, Basic Science Research

name: Shin Lin Let
bio: Shin Lin Let is a fourth-year medical student at the University of Liverpool, having transferred from IMU, Malaysia, after completing her preclinical training. Her academic journey began with her passing the matriculation exam. She then went on to complete her A-levels in the United Kingdom. Throughout her journey, Shin received multiple interview invitations from medical schools across the UK, Ireland, Australia, and Malaysia. From her interview experience, she has developed strong skills in medical school applications, especially in writing personal statements and understanding what universities are looking for. Shin also understands the current challenges around study visa restrictions, and she can guide students on alternative pathways and options to eventually work as a doctor in the UK. She enjoys helping students navigate the application process and aims to make it less stressful and more achievable. Shin is passionate about supporting others in reaching their goals and getting into competitive university programmes.

name: Thuta Ye Moe
bio: Graduating with a Bachelor of Science in Engineering with a major in Energy & Environmental Science and Engineering from Yonsei University, Thuta combines academic research with a dedication to guiding students through international educational opportunities. His research experience spans computational energy materials design, waste-to-energy production, and life cycle assessment. As a Graduate Research Student at the Computational Energy Materials Laboratory, his current research work focuses on sulfide-based solid-state electrolytes for energy storage systems. He previously completed a research internship at the Institute of Sustainability for Chemicals, Energy, and Environment under A*STAR in Singapore. Thuta has recently received offers to pursue a DPhil in Engineering Science at the University of Oxford and a PhD in Engineering and IT at the University of Melbourne with the Melbourne Research Scholarship. Through his academic and research experiences, he is passionate about helping students navigate university admissions and scholarship applications, and build clear pathways toward their academic goals.

name: Wutt Hmone Thin Kyi
bio: Wutt Hmone Thin Kyi grew up in Yangon, Myanmar, until the age of ten before moving to Singapore, where she continued her education and completed her GCE O-Level examinations. She later received a full scholarship to attend United World College Changshu China, where she completed her high school education in an internationally diverse academic environment. Wutt then earned a full scholarship to pursue her undergraduate degree in Biomedical Engineering, with a minor in Neuropsychology, at Bucknell University in the United States. She is currently a fully funded PhD candidate in Biomedical Engineering at the University of Michigan, focusing on Neural Engineering and advancing neuromodulation therapies. Her research aims to improve treatments, such as spinal cord stimulation, by integrating clinical research with computational modeling to develop more personalized and effective electrical therapies for patients with chronic pain.
